name: Love Express — Journey to Forever
descriptionEn: An interactive pixel-art wedding invitation. Guide the Love Courier through three story stations in order, discover the couple, date and venue, then reach the Love Express for RSVP and wishes.
descriptionIdn: Undangan pernikahan pixel-art interaktif. Antar Love Courier melewati tiga stasiun cerita secara berurutan—mempelai, waktu, dan lokasi—lalu tiba di Love Express untuk RSVP dan ucapan.
